scene_description: A family Thanksgiving dinner scene with a large wooden table covered in holiday food including a roasted turkey, fruits, vegetables, corn, candles, and small pumpkins. Two young children are near the table, and several adults stand around holding wine glasses.

questions.evidence_hint: Look in the middle of the table for something glowing.

questions.question: Who is standing next to the table?
questions.evidence_hint: Look on the left and right sides of the table.

questions.question: What small orange things are on the table?
questions.evidence_hint: Look around the table for small round orange decorations.

questions.question: Where is all the food?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big wooden surface in the middle of the picture.
